plan.name: Search for pan in cabinets and drawers first
plan.strategy: Prioritize checking storage areas (cabinets and drawers) where pans are commonly stored, then proceed to clean and place the pan on the countertop.
steps: Check cabinets 1 to 6 and drawers 1 to 3 for a pan.
If a pan is found, take it to the sinkbasin 1.
Clean the pan in the sinkbasin 1.
Place the cleaned pan on one of the countertops (1, 2, or 3).
